title: Introduction to HTML
description: HTML (HyperText Markup Language) is the standard language used to create and structure web pages.
It serves as the foundation of every website by organizing content such as text, images, videos, links, and forms.
HTML uses tags and elements to tell the browser how content should appear on the screen.
Learning HTML is the first step in web development because it provides the basic structure that other technologies like CSS and JavaScript build upon.

Welcome to My Website

This is my first HTML page.
